name: Carly
tagline: AI agents you email to handle scheduling, inbox, CRM and more
description: Carly (formerly CalBot) gives you AI agents with their own email address: you CC them to schedule meetings, sort your inbox and update your CRM. GAIA is a personal assistant you reach from chat apps, the web and the desktop, with workflows across your tools.
metaTitle: Carly AI vs GAIA: Email Agents or a Personal AI Assistant
metaDescription: Carly runs AI agents you CC on email, with a huge app catalog and phone add-ons. GAIA is a personal assistant in your chat apps, web and desktop. Compare.
intro: Carly started as CalBot, a scheduling assistant you CC on email, and has grown into a platform of AI agents. Each agent has its own name, email address, integrations and permissions, and you reach it by email, SMS, Slack, its dashboard chat or from Claude and ChatGPT over MCP. Its catalog spans CRMs, accounting, support desks and hundreds more apps, and teams can add business calling and an AI receptionist. GAIA is one personal assistant rather than a set of agents. It triages your inbox, manages your calendar and tasks, remembers your preferences, runs workflows triggered by your tools and is reachable from iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and Discord as well as its web and desktop apps. GAIA does not make or answer phone calls.

rows.gaia: One personal AI assistant that works across email, calendar, tasks and your other tools
rows.competitor: A platform of AI agents, each with its own name, email address, integrations and permissions

rows.gaia: iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack and Discord, plus a web app and a desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux
rows.competitor: Email (CC your agent), SMS, Slack, a dashboard chat, a Chrome extension, and Claude or ChatGPT over MCP

rows.gaia: Finds open time, creates and edits Google Calendar events and drafts scheduling emails
rows.competitor: Core strength: books meetings from email threads, with booking pages and group scheduling

rows.gaia: Gmail, Outlook, Google Calendar, Slack, Notion, GitHub, Linear, Todoist, Asana, HubSpot and more, plus custom MCP servers
rows.competitor: A very large catalog, including CRMs such as Attio, Pipedrive and Zoho, accounting tools such as QuickBooks and Xero, and support desks such as Zendesk

rows.gaia: Multi-step workflows on a schedule or triggered by Gmail, Google Calendar, Slack, GitHub and more
rows.competitor: Workflow templates, scheduled tasks and custom skills, with AI steps metered in credits
Business calling and an AI receptionist as paid add-ons for teams

rows.gaia: Long-term memory of your preferences and people that you can view, edit and delete in settings
Source-available (PolyForm Noncommercial) with self-hosting via Docker; for-profit organizations self-host under an enterprise license
Hosted Pro at ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month per person; GAIA Enterprise priced on request
rows.competitor: A free tier with MCP access and basic workflows, then a Personal plan and per-seat Organization plans with usage metered in credits; Enterprise on request

gaiaAdvantages: Text it from iMessage, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack or Discord
A web app and a desktop app for longer work
One subscription instead of credits that run out
Memory you can see, edit and delete
competitorAdvantages: Nothing new to learn: you CC an agent on the email you were already writing
A far larger catalog of business apps, from CRMs to accounting and support desks
Phone handling for teams, with business calling and an AI receptionist
verdict: Choose Carly if you want agents that live in email, need its CRM, accounting or support integrations, or want an AI receptionist on the phone. Choose GAIA if you want one personal assistant you can text from your chat apps, with a web and desktop app, workflows across your tools, memory you control and code you can inspect.

faqs.question: What is the difference between Carly and GAIA?
faqs.answer: Carly gives you AI agents with their own email addresses that you CC to schedule, sort email and update tools, with usage metered in credits. GAIA is one personal assistant you reach from chat apps, the web and the desktop, with workflows and memory across your email, calendar and tools.

faqs.question: Can GAIA answer phone calls like Carly?
faqs.answer: No. GAIA does not make or answer phone calls. If you need an AI receptionist or business calling, Carly offers them as add-ons for teams.

faqs.question: Can I CC GAIA on an email like Carly?
faqs.answer: GAIA works inside your connected Gmail or Outlook account instead: it reads the thread, drafts the reply and books the meeting on your calendar. You ask it from chat, the web or the desktop rather than by adding a CC.

faqs.question: How much does GAIA cost compared with Carly?
faqs.answer: Carly has a free tier, a Personal plan and per-seat Organization plans, with AI usage metered in credits. GAIA's hosted service is a paid subscription per person, with Pro at ${{PRO_MONTHLY_PRICE}}/month, and GAIA Enterprise is priced on request. The code is source-available under the PolyForm Noncommercial license, so self-hosting is free for personal, noncommercial use, and for-profit organizations self-host under an enterprise license (contact the GAIA team).
